bienvenida.cuerpo: No card and no automatic charge. When it ends, you choose: keep Élite or stay on the free plan.

incluye.coach: The Élite coach, with a daily message cap during the trial: morning brief, day plan, chat, weekly review, training and diet.
incluye.revision: Extended weekly review: the week, your body profile and your progress.
incluye.laurel: The laurel badge next to your name. It's status, not points.
incluye.ludus: Request a place in a ludus, a private group of 5 to 8 Élite gladiators. Groups form little by little: requesting a place doesn't guarantee one.
incluye.profundo: Deep mode belongs to paid Élite and isn't part of the trial.

gratis.lista: Habits, missions, XP, streak, contract, campaigns, agenda, gym, cardio, nutrition, journal, progress, friends and ranking.
